headline: Sensex falls 319 points, Nifty slips below 25,150 as inflation concerns weigh on market

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Rising crude oil prices revived inflation concerns, weighing heavily on market sentiment.
Major market heavyweights including HDFC Bank and Titan faced selling pressure.
Indices snapped their winning streak despite initial support from early trade gains.
Global market volatility and shifting U.S. rate hike expectations influenced investor caution.
whatHappening: Sensex closed 319 points lower while Nifty50 ended at 25,144.
Shriram Finance emerged as the top loser on Nifty50.
Manappuram Finance shares dropped 4% during the session.
ABB India reported a 10% profit growth in Q3 to ₹440 crore with record orders.
summary: Indian benchmark indices snapped their winning streak on November 13 as the Sensex fell 319 points and Nifty closed at 25,144. Concerns over inflation due to rising crude oil prices dragged down financial and retail stocks. Meanwhile, ABB India stood out with strong quarterly results, recording a 10% increase in net profit.
